_comment: Dated promises from the apps' signup copy. kind: 'date' (send on date, catch-up for grace_days), 'monthly' (day N of each month from..to), 'before_field' (days_before a per-subscriber date field; fallback_date if blank). Each (id, subscriber) is sent once (salted-hash state). Optional send_at (UTC) schedules the Kit broadcast later that day. Links carry ?ref=email-<tag>.

reminders.subject: Wrapped season is here: request your TikTok export
body: Wrapped season is open. This is the one reminder you asked for: request your TikTok data export now, because it can take a few days to arrive. The page has the steps.
When the export lands, drop it into Scroll Wrapped to make your cards. The messages section is thrown away the moment the file is opened, and nothing leaves your device.
Make your Scroll Wrapped: https://lanternlab2027.github.io/lab/tiktok/?ref=email-scroll-wrapped

That's the only email this list sends.
To stop this, use the unsubscribe link below (it stops all Lantern Lab email).

Open Year in Orders: https://lanternlab2027.github.io/lab/amazon/?ref=email-year-in-orders

Not tax advice. We'll write once more, when next year's recap is ready.

reminders.subject: Tax time: export your Timeline for your mileage log
body: Here's the January reminder you asked for: export your Google Maps Timeline and build last year's mileage log.

Timeline's auto-delete can remove old trips, so export soon. Then drop the file into the tool, tag trips business or personal and download your CSV. The page has the steps. Your trips never leave your device.
Build your log: https://lanternlab2027.github.io/lab/mileage/?ref=email-mileage-log

Not tax advice. Check your log against your calendar and receipts. That's the only email this list sends.
